CheckTitle: OpenAI organizations export audit logs to an external system
Description: This check verifies that the organization's **audit log** is readable and exported to an external system, so records of key creation, member changes and project configuration survive outside the platform.
Risk: API key creation is the single most security-relevant event in an OpenAI organization, and without exported logs there is **no durable record of who minted which key and when**. During an investigation into leaked model access or unexpected spend, that gap makes it impossible to distinguish legitimate provisioning from an attacker establishing persistence.

Code.Other:
1. Confirm your plan includes audit log access
2. Build or enable a scheduled export that pulls `/v1/organization/audit_logs` into your SIEM
3. Alert on `api_key.created`, `invite.sent`, `organization.updated` and `project.created` events
4. Alert specifically on admin key creation, which grants organization-wide control
5. Retain the exported logs according to your incident investigation window

Recommendation.Text: Export the OpenAI audit log into your SIEM on a schedule and alert on API key creation, member invitations and organization setting changes.
